mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% in a month triggers a forward discounting effect, lowering expected future returns and producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, SPX 20d returns remain non-negative despite persistent CPIAUCSL > 0.3, or inflation decays before 20d horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 200,000 new jobs in a month signals labor market strength, which supports corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 12-month period, SPX 60d returns are not statistically higher than during PAYEMS ≤ 200000 months.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by at least 2% in two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side constraints, prompting investors to anticipate demand recovery and positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: No significant SPX 20d outperformance in similar structural weakness episodes without demand recovery.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS falls by more than 5% in a month, it reflects excess supply in the credit market, reducing risk premiums and producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Repeated RSAFS drops fail to predict negative SPX 5d returns in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% for three consecutive months creates a patient investor environment, increasing S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: No significant SPX 60d outperformance during extended low-rate periods without other catalysts.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 5.5% in a month coincides with higher discounting of future earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: No negative SPX 20d returns during UNRATE > 5.5 months, or returns revert when rates fall.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of GDP-like demand momentum (HOUST > 1050) indicates robust consumer confidence, supporting equity valuation expansion and positive S&P 20-day returns.
failure_condition: No positive SPX 20d returns during such demand phases when other risk factors are neutral.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between falling INDPRO and rising FEDFUNDS creates a dual signal of supply stress and tighter policy, producing negative S&P 60-day returns.
failure_condition: No significant negative SPX 60d returns during co-occurrence of these proxies in non-crisis regimes.
